# Revised results (generated by make_results_md.py)

All values are MtCO₂/yr at full operation, transmission included, net basis. "Central" = all factors at their best-supported central values (deterministic). "MC" = Monte Carlo median with 5–95% range (shared factors drawn once per draw). Net = fossil added minus clean avoided (positive = fossil larger). Per the statistics review, no probability is reported for US cells: the US sign is close to a one-factor call on pipeline displacement.

Phase 1 global/net clean-to-fossil ratio (MC): 0.66 [0.48–1.07], i.e. fossil about 1.5x clean (0.9–2.1x).

## Mt brought forward (internal only; not a valid clean-vs-fossil effect estimate)

CGEP replays end at the federal decision, so post-approval suits, where the clean/fossil difference sits, are outside them. Depletables get 0 months. Pooled 2010–24, central:

| Case | Transmission | US clean / fossil | Global clean / fossil |
|---|---|---|---|
| covered_types (unmatched at type mean) | in | 39.9 / 19.4 | 39.9 / 24.0 |
| covered_types (unmatched at type mean) | out | 7.8 / 19.4 | 7.8 / 24.0 |
| uncovered flow assets=pipeline median (1.5 mo) | in | 59.0 / 25.1 | 59.0 / 34.4 |
| uncovered flow assets=pipeline median (1.5 mo) | out | 26.8 / 25.1 | 26.8 / 34.4 |
